column2: Before I start, I check the Enter button, the average button, the quiz Return button and three lines in Global.cs.
Each time the data entry form opens it is brand new and empty, but Global.cs still holds everything.
The Load event switches every panel off, asks Global.cs three questions, then fills the boxes and switches on the right panel.
The first lines of the Load event switch off all five panels on the data entry form.
If the quiz has been taken, the score shows in black, Take quiz is hidden and the reaction test panel switches on.
When the quiz has been taken, the surname, first name, gender and year group go back from Global.cs into their boxes.
If the quiz is not taken, the details panel switches on and the quiz status says Quiz not taken yet in red.
If the average is worked out, the three attempts and the average go back in their boxes and the average button hides.
If the reaction test is taken, its score shows, Take test hides, its panel switches off and the group panel switches on.
I run the program and check that only the details panel works at first, and that the quiz brings the details back.
